method.elapsed: Sum of awaited render/export calls, including failures; initialization, warm-up, reporting and cleanup excluded. Native CLI includes process startup.
method.png: Browser SVG + shared Chromium canvas PNG conversion unless a prepared native PNG path is available. No image inspection.

configuration.pngPaths: Shared Chromium SVG-to-PNG conversion for browser SVG renderers; Merslim public PNG API; Mermaid RS native PNG CLI writes encoded bytes to /dev/null.
configuration.clock: Browser render/export API calls; native CLI includes process startup. Failed-call times are included.

transportCorrections: Use the corrected three-run collections for Agentic Mermaid, Pele and Mermaid RS Renderer. Initial URL-loader setup failures and the Rust PNG stdout-socket transport failure are excluded. Original numeric attempts remain local; no image outputs were retained.

rankingRule.primary: More completed examples is better; use the minimum completion count across three complete runs.
rankingRule.secondary: For equal completion counts, lower median total render/export time is better.
rankingRule.ties: Identical completion counts and median times share a rank.
rankingRule.scope: Rank SVG and PNG separately through the declared public execution paths. Native CLI time includes per-example process startup.
rankingRule.incomplete: Fewer than three complete runs, or mixed versions/boundaries, remain unranked.
